start.text: Hey! This is our Bambu Lab X1E with the AMS. Students use this for projects, including Senior Design.

choices.label: I'm going to keep looking around.

main2.text: It's great when you want to turn a CAD design into a real part. That makes it really useful for prototypes and project ideas.

main3.text: The X1E can work with many standard and engineering materials. That gives students options depending on what their design needs.

main4.text: The big idea is being able to design, print, test, and improve. You can learn a lot once your design becomes a physical object.

choices.label: What do you mean by prototype?
I'm going to check out another printer.

main5.text: That's the Bambu Lab X1E! Ask me anything else, or check out the other machines.

choices.label: How is this used in Senior Design?

ams.text: AMS stands for Automatic Material System. It can automatically manage different filament spools for the printer.

ams_switching.text: Exactly! That can make multi-material or multi-color printing easier. The system handles switching between the loaded filaments.

choices.label: Why would I need different materials?

student_projects.text: It could be a prototype, enclosure, bracket, or project component. The exact part really depends on what they're designing.

materials.text: Different materials can behave differently in strength and flexibility. Engineers choose materials based on what the part needs to do.

choices.label: Can the AMS hold different materials?

senior_design.text: Senior Design teams often need to turn ideas into real prototypes. Printing lets them test a design instead of only seeing it on-screen.

choices.label: What if the design doesn't work?

prototype.text: Think of a prototype as a test version of your design. You build it, find problems, improve it, and try again.

choices.label: So you can print it again?

iteration.text: Exactly! That repeated improvement is called iteration. It's a really important part of engineering design.

choices.label: How does that help Senior Design?

bye.text: Sounds good! Feel free to keep looking around. Come back if you want to learn more.
